card.title: Delete account
card.ownerBody: Deleting your account permanently deletes your whole business: its properties, residents and their records, invoices, payments, staff logins and uploaded files.
card.staffBody: Deleting your account removes your login and the personal details we hold about you. Records you created for the business stay with it, without your name.
card.loadFailed: Could not load your account details.

dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.ownerIntro: This permanently deletes the whole business, including:
ownerItems: All residents and their records, including uploaded ID documents
All invoices, payments, complaints, visitors and expenses
dialog.staffIntro: This removes your login, your notification settings and devices, and the personal details we hold about you.
dialog.exportHint: Export anything you need before you confirm — nothing can be recovered afterwards.
dialog.waiting: Your account is locked straight away and deleted permanently after a waiting period. You can cancel until the deletion starts, and you will see the date next.
dialog.retained: We keep only the billing records of your PGLive subscription that tax law requires.
dialog.understand: I understand that my account will be permanently deleted.

methods.otp_email: A code sent to my email

dialog.codeSent: We have emailed you a code.
dialog.codeFailed: Could not send a code. Please try again.
dialog.noMethod: This account cannot be confirmed online. Please contact support to delete it.
dialog.failed: We could not start the deletion. Please try again.
dialog.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.

pending.loadFailed: Could not load the status of your account.
pending.titlePending: Your account is scheduled for deletion
pending.ownBusinessBody: Your whole business will be permanently deleted on {date}.
pending.ownAccountBody: Your account will be permanently deleted on {date}.
pending.staffBody: Your organisation is being deleted by its owner. Your access ends on {date}.
pending.locked: Until then the account is locked.
pending.canCancel: Changed your mind? You can cancel the deletion any time before then.
pending.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can cancel this deletion.
pending.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the deletion. Please try again.
pending.processingBody: The deletion has started and can no longer be cancelled. You will be signed out when it finishes.
pending.failedBody: Something went wrong while deleting this account. Our support team has been notified and will sort it out.
